verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gazebo ships major-versioned libraries (e.g. `gz-sim10`, the `gz-jetty` metapackage) and documents which ROS and Gazebo versions are currently supported together, so APIs are versioned. Nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy or how breaking changes are announced and phased out. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, documented API stability or semver guarantees, migration or changelog guidance, and independent corroboration.
